# env/overlay/bin

## Overview
Executable CLI utilities and zero-dependency stdio MCP servers overlaid into `$PREFIX/bin`. Provides native Android host/gateway MCP tools (`agy-mcp-android`), Chrome DevTools-compatible Android WebView MCP automation (`agy-mcp-browser`), background task scheduling (`agy-daemon`), Android notification dispatch (`agy-notify`), state backup/restore and APK upgrades (`agy-upgrade`), prefix/shebang rewriting (`agy-fix-paths`), Shizuku privileged shell execution (`rish`), and a language-server lookup stub (`cs`).

## Interface
- `[agy-mcp-android:main]` Python 3 JSON-RPC 2.0 / MCP stdio server (`SERVER_NAME='android-device'`, `SERVER_VERSION='1.0.0'`, flags `--version`/`-v`, `--help`/`-h`) handling `initialize`, `ping`, `tools/list`, `tools/call`, and `notifications/*`.
- `[agy-mcp-android:TOOLS]` Exposes 13 MCP tools: `android_device_info`, `android_notify`, `android_wait_approval`, `android_subagent_notify`, `android_voice_service`, `android_clipboard_get`, `android_clipboard_set`, `android_toast`, `android_vibrate`, `android_torch`, `android_shizuku_exec`, `android_browser_automate`, and `android_schedule_task`.
- `[agy-mcp-android:get_gateway_port]` and `[agy-mcp-android:get_gateway_token]` Read env vars `PREFIX`, `HOME`, `AGY_GATEWAY_PORT`, `AGY_GATEWAY_TOKEN`, `AGY_GATEWAY_TOKEN_FILE`, `AGY_RISH_BIN`, `AGY_DAEMON_BIN` (default port `45160`) and call loopback `POST http://127.0.0.1:<port>/gateway` (`[agy-mcp-android:gateway_post]`) or `GET` (`[agy-mcp-android:gateway_get]`) with header `X-Agy-Gateway-Token`.
- `[agy-mcp-browser:main]` Python 3 JSON-RPC 2.0 / MCP stdio server (`SERVER_NAME='chrome-devtools'`, `SERVER_VERSION='1.0.0'`, flags `--version`/`-v`, `--help`/`-h`) handling `initialize`, `ping`, `tools/list`, `tools/call`, and `notifications/*` via `[agy-mcp-browser:gateway_browser]` (`POST /gateway` command `browser_auto`).
- `[agy-mcp-browser:TOOLS]` Exposes 13 MCP tools: `list_pages`, `new_page`, `select_page`, `close_page`, `navigate_page`, `take_snapshot`, `take_screenshot`, `click`, `fill`, `press_key`, `evaluate_script`, `list_console_messages`, and `wait_for`.
- `[agy-mcp-browser:get_gateway_port]` and `[agy-mcp-browser:get_gateway_token]` Read `PREFIX`, `HOME`, `AGY_GATEWAY_PORT`, `AGY_GATEWAY_TOKEN`, and `AGY_GATEWAY_TOKEN_FILE` (default port `45160`).
- `[agy-daemon:main]` Python 3 CLI importing `daemon.{scheduler,triggers,executor}` from `../lib` (`[agy-daemon:_OVERLAY_LIB]`), exposing lifecycle commands (`start [-f|--foreground]`, `stop`, `restart`, `status`), shortcuts (`add`, `list`, `remove`, `clear`), and `task {add,list,remove,pause,resume,run-now,logs}` with `--json` and `--active-only`.
- `[agy-daemon:cmd_task_add]` Accepts `--name`, `--command`, `--prompt`, `--project`, `--conversation-id` (fallback `[agy-daemon:AGY_CONVERSATION_ID]`), `--delay`, `--interval`, `--cron`, `--github-pr`, `--github-issue`, `--watch-file`, `--battery-below`, `--webhook-port`, `--webhook-token`, `--wake-app`, and `--json`.
- `[agy-notify:CMD]` Bash CLI (`post` [default], `cancel <tag>`, `list`) accepting `-t|--title`, `-s|--subtitle`, `-m|--message`, `--tag`, `-c|--channel`, `--cascade-id <id>`, and env vars `PREFIX`, `HOME` (default `$(dirname "$PREFIX")`), `AGY_GATEWAY_PORT`, `AGY_GATEWAY_TOKEN`, `AGY_GATEWAY_TOKEN_FILE`, and `AGY_LOGO`; resolves gateway port (`AGY_GATEWAY_PORT -> $HOME/logs/gateway.port -> $HOME/logs/core.state.json['gateway_port'] -> 45161/45160`) and posts envelope `{"command":"notify","payload":{...}}` to `http://127.0.0.1:<port>/gateway` (`[agy-notify:gateway_notify]`) verifying HTTP 200 and `ok: true`, with `rish` and `cmd notification` fallbacks.
- `[agy-upgrade:ACTION]` Bash/Python CLI (`backup [dest]`, `restore [archive]`, `apply|install <apk>`, `list`, `status`, `help|--help|-h`) managing archives under `[agy-upgrade:BACKUP_ROOT]` (`/storage/emulated/0/Documents/antigravity-backup`) and reading `PREFIX` and `HOME`.
- `[agy-fix-paths:targets]` Bash CLI `agy-fix-paths [PATH...]` (defaults to `[agy-fix-paths:PREFIX]`) rewriting Android prefix paths and line-1 `/usr/bin/env` shebangs to `$PREFIX`.
- `[rish:exec]` POSIX `sh` launcher forwarding all arguments to `/system/bin/app_process` (`rikka.shizuku.shell.ShizukuShellLoader`), reading `PREFIX`, `RISH_APPLICATION_ID`, and `AGY_APPLICATION_ID`, and locating `rish_shizuku.dex` (`[rish:DEX]`).
- `[cs:exit 0]` No-op `/bin/sh` stub immediately exiting `0`.

## Invariants
- `[agy-mcp-android:get_gateway_port]` and `[agy-mcp-browser:get_gateway_port]` Validate resolved ports in `1..65535` following precedence `AGY_GATEWAY_PORT -> $HOME/logs/gateway.port -> $HOME/logs/core.state.json['gateway_port'] -> 45160` and connect exclusively to `127.0.0.1`.
- `[agy-mcp-android:handle_message]` and `[agy-mcp-browser:handle_message]` Negotiate MCP protocol versions strictly from `('2025-06-18', '2025-03-26', '2024-11-05')` (default `'2024-11-05'`), emit no reply for notifications, and wrap tool errors/exceptions as JSON-RPC results with `isError=True`.
- `[agy-mcp-android:handle_wait_approval]` Clamps `timeout_sec` to `[1.0, 300.0]`s and `poll_interval_ms` to `[200, 5000]`ms; `[agy-mcp-android:handle_vibrate]` clamps `duration_ms` to `[10, 5000]`ms; `[agy-mcp-android:handle_shizuku_exec]` clamps `timeout_sec` to `[1, 300]`s and truncates stdout/stderr independently to `MAX_CMD_OUTPUT_BYTES` (`65536` UTF-8 bytes).
- `[agy-mcp-android:handle_notify]` Auto-generates `request_id` (`req_` + 12 hex chars) when `actions`, `approval`, or `type=='tool_approval'` is supplied without one; `[agy-mcp-android:_run_daemon_cli]` executes `agy-daemon` via argv list (no shell) with a `20`s timeout.
- `[agy-mcp-browser:handle_select_page]` Enforces a single-page model (`pageId=1`); `[agy-mcp-browser:_resolve_selector]` prioritizes CSS-escaped `uid` over `selector`; `[agy-mcp-browser:SNAPSHOT_JS]` caps snapshots at `160` elements / `8000` body chars (`300` / `16000` when `verbose`); `[agy-mcp-browser:handle_take_screenshot]` inlines base64 PNGs only up to `2097152` bytes; `[agy-mcp-browser:handle_wait_for]` clamps timeout to `[0.5, 60.0]`s.
- `[agy-daemon:sys.dont_write_bytecode]` Disables `.pyc` writes; `[agy-daemon:acquire_daemon_lock]` / `[agy-daemon:is_lock_held]` synchronize single-instance execution via `fcntl.flock(LOCK_EX | LOCK_NB)` on `LOCK_FILE` (`daemon.lock`), `daemonize()` finishes the parent with `os._exit(0)`, `[agy-daemon:get_running_pid]` verifies `/proc/<pid>/cmdline` belongs to `agy-daemon`, `[agy-daemon:cmd_start]` refuses duplicate starts when `is_lock_held()` or a live PID is detected, and `[agy-daemon:cmd_stop]` sends `SIGTERM`, waits up to `3.0`s (`15 x 0.2s`), and escalates to `SIGKILL`.
- `[agy-daemon:cmd_task_add]` Exits `1` if no trigger flag is given and evaluates trigger flags in strict `if/elif` order (`delay > interval > cron > github_pr > github_issue > watch_file > battery_below > webhook_port`, so `--interval` overrides watcher branches if combined); auto-generates 32-byte URL-safe webhook tokens when `--webhook-token` is omitted.
- `[agy-daemon:cmd_task_remove]` Removes all tasks matching `id` or `name`, whereas `pause`, `resume` (setting `enabled=True, executed=False`), `run-now`, and `logs` match only the first entry.
- `[agy-notify:post]` Runs under `set -e`, promotes `TITLE` into `MESSAGE` if `MESSAGE` is empty, computes a positive 31-bit CRC32 notification ID, and falls back in order: loopback gateway HTTP -> `rish cmd notification` -> direct `cmd notification` -> stdout log.
- `[agy-upgrade:cmd_restore]` Runs under `set -euo pipefail`, enforces tar path-traversal safety (`filter='data'` or `realpath` containment under `$HOME`), and auto-reinstalls only `manifests['pkg']` (not `pip`/`npm`).
- `[agy-upgrade:cmd_apply]` Always completes a `pre_update_<timestamp>.tar.gz` backup before installing an APK and uses `rish -c pm install -r` only when `rish -c id` returns `uid=`.
- `[agy-fix-paths:grep -rIlZ]` Rewrites only non-binary regular files (skipping symlinks `[ -L ]`), replacing a file only when `sed` succeeds and `cmp -s` reports changes while preserving octal mode bits via `stat -c '%a'`.
- `[rish:SDK]` On Android SDK `>= 34`, enforces non-writable `rish_shizuku.dex` (`chmod 400`, exiting `1` if still writable), requires a non-empty `RISH_APPLICATION_ID`, and strips `LD_PRELOAD` and `LD_LIBRARY_PATH` via `env -u` before `exec`.
- `[cs:exit 0]` Unconditionally exits `0` regardless of arguments.

## Side Effects
- `[agy-mcp-android:gateway_post]` and `[agy-mcp-android:gateway_get]` Issue loopback HTTP calls triggering Android device telemetry, notifications, approval polling, voice foreground service control, clipboard reads/writes, toasts, vibration, torch toggling, and offscreen WebView automation; `[agy-mcp-android:handle_shizuku_exec]` and `[agy-mcp-android:handle_torch]` spawn `rish` subprocesses; `[agy-mcp-android:_run_daemon_cli]` spawns `agy-daemon` subprocesses.
- `[agy-mcp-browser:gateway_browser]` Sends loopback HTTP `browser_auto` requests that drive WebView navigation, mutate live DOM (`data-agy-uid` attributes in `[agy-mcp-browser:SNAPSHOT_JS]`), dispatch keyboard events/form submits (`[agy-mcp-browser:handle_press_key]`), clear console buffers, write PNG screenshots to disk, and optionally write snapshot files via `[agy-mcp-browser:handle_take_snapshot]`.
- `[agy-daemon:daemonize]` Double-forks the background scheduler, writes/removes `PID_FILE`, redirects output to `LOG_FILE`, mutates `TASKS_FILE` on task subcommands, and triggers async execution via `[agy-daemon:cmd_task_run_now]`.
- `[agy-notify:gateway_notify]` and `[agy-notify:post]` Send `{"command":"notify","payload":...}` HTTP requests to `/gateway`, cache logos at `/data/local/tmp/agy_logo.png` via `rish`, post/cancel Android system notifications, and run `dumpsys notification --noredact` on `list`.
- `[agy-upgrade:BACKUP_ROOT]` Unconditionally runs `mkdir -p /storage/emulated/0/Documents/antigravity-backup`; `backup`/`restore`/`apply` create/overwrite tarballs and `latest.tar.gz`, extract into `$HOME`, run `pkg install` and `agy-fix-paths`, install APKs via `rish pm install -r`, or stage `/storage/emulated/0/Download/agy_update.apk`.
- `[agy-fix-paths:mv]` Writes temporary `<file>.agyfix.<pid>` files and atomically replaces modified text files in place.
- `[rish:SDK]` May `chmod 400` `rish_shizuku.dex` on SDK `>= 34` and `[rish:exec]` replaces the current process via `exec /system/bin/app_process`.

## Verification
- Run: `python3 -B -m unittest discover -s env/tests -v`
- Run: `bash env/build.sh assets && bash env/tests/invariant`
